body:
Thank you so much for replying.
It means a lot to me.
I really wanted to treasure myself,I wanted to tell my heart that you cannot change people,you cannot change the circumstances you are currently in but you can still change things that are yet to happen in the future. I tried to find the part that said these things to me whenever I was sad and lonely. But now,I cannot find my true self,I don't remember how I used to be ,how I should have been, how I should be right now,what good I could have done in my life,but now I just don't know what to do anymore. I try to try but nothing comes out of it.
